summary: The diff ports home-swe-home from bare anima to magitech-harness: the CLI builds context via create_harness(), registers the Gemini adapter, all 15 tools via define_tool + ctx.tools.register, and prompt sections via ctx.system_prompt.section/context. The turn loop now uses ctx.agents.create/followup/when_idle, and all listed removed modules (core_loop.py, client.py, native.py, contracts.py, tools/executor.py, the 15 Service classes, utils/stream.py, utils/schema.py, utils/native_events.py) are deleted. Sandbox is default-on with --no-sandbox/HOME_SWE_HOME_SANDBOX=0 opt-in, documented in README and DESIGN. Every tool's text output is redacted through the shared _render_text render step at the output boundary.
